features.title: Official PJZ110 OKI and GKI
features.scope: Full locked 35-project OKI modules, DTB/DTBO, ABI/KMI, firmware, Image, boot. GKI separate; not automatic no-wipe.

features.title: Additional SM8750 kernel variants
features.scope: 6.6.30 OnePlus13, 6.6.56 OnePlus13T, 6.6.57 Pad2Pro, 6.6.66/6.6.89 OnePlus13, 6.6.118 shown in Actions. Each requires own source and device gate.

features.title: MT6991 OnePlus Ace5 Supreme
features.scope: Separate MediaTek 6.6.50 source/toolchain/vendor target; not SM8750-compatible by assertion.

features.title: Root providers and SUSFS
features.scope: Official KernelSU, BakaSU, ReSukiSU, SukiSU Ultra, KernelSU-Next. One pinned provider per build, exact hook/kernel/SUSFS compatibility.

features.title: Hooks
features.scope: Kprobes, manual, syscall/tracepoint and SUSFS inline checked per upstream commit. Struck-through legacy screenshot item is NOT automatically supported.

features.title: Fengchi governor
features.scope: Vendor original scx/HMBIRD and its sched modules/KABI; preserve stable OEM scheduling by default.

features.title: ccache-ECS
features.scope: Stage 7.3 cache policy already exists. Shared preseed and ~6-min claims need trusted byte provenance and comparable cold/warm benchmarks; no automatic user-cache deletion.

features.title: Compiler O2
features.scope: Opt-in, measurable optimization with unchanged security flags CFI/KCFI and OEM ABI/KMI.

features.title: Compression and ZRAM
features.scope: LZ4 1.10.0, zstd 1.5.7 kernel-compatible backports; built-in ZRAM versus zram.ko, actual runtime tests.

features.title: TCP algorithms
features.scope: Existing BBR/Westwood/BBG plus Brutal; BBG source/meaning to be reviewed. Per-algorithm Kconfig and behavior.

features.title: Netfilter configuration
features.scope: ipset, iptables, IPv4/IPv6 advanced networking capabilities conditional on vendor kernel and userspace.

features.title: ADIOS I/O
features.scope: Optional Linux 6.6 block-mq and UFS/OEM driver compatibility tests.

features.title: Droidspaces
features.scope: Namespaces, seccomp, cgroups, networking, OverlayFS and actual container runtime requirements.

features.title: Mountify
features.scope: Root/module requirements, source pin and Android-version validation.

features.title: Re:Kernel/Freezer/NoActive
features.scope: Userspace interfaces, measured power behavior, compatibility and rollback.

features.title: Baseband-guard
features.scope: Audit partition protection source/license and safe OTA/recovery carve-outs; cannot promise total protection from wipes.

features.title: GKI F2FS data preservation
features.scope: Experimental no-wipe compatibility study only. Backup and explicit device tests; no data-safety guarantee.

features.title: NetHunter monitor mode
features.scope: Optional driver/firmware/USB wireless compatibility, not asserted on built-in WiFi.

features.title: kexec
features.scope: Secure boot/signature, SELinux, rollback and physical-device impact study.

features.title: Unicode zero-width request
features.scope: Preserved, not implemented until source and precise behavior are established.

features.title: Actions/build versions and delivery
features.scope: Independent pinned Run IDs, source/patch lock, artifact sha, modules and ABI verification. Public release gated in Stage 9.
